name: Runemaster Elementalist raises Weapon Engraving damage by 10% (#1662)
contract: Elementalist 300583 reads 'Increases the damage dealt by your Weapon Engravings by $s1%.' Its one effect is a
native percent SPELLMOD_DAMAGE modifier, BasePoints 9 with DieSides 1 = +10%, on family 38 mask0 0x8000000:
Fire Engraving 'Damage' 653212 (the Firebrand explosion), Water Engraving 'Damage' 653215 and 'Slow' 653230,
Earth Engraving 'Damage' 653220 and Air Engraving 'Damage' 653224. The passive needs no script. No
CharacterAdvancement entry grants 300583 (only SkillLineAbility 91170 with AcquireMethod 0 lists it), so it is
learned here as a fixture. The Earth Engraving proc damage Weapon Engraving: Earth 653272 carries mask0
0x20000 and is outside the modifier's data scope. Expected: the four engraving damage spells deal 10% more,
653272 is unchanged, and the bonus leaves with the passive.
